newsitem.title: USA: Laclede Steel Q4 productivity falls short.
newsitem.headline: Laclede Steel Q4 productivity falls short.

text.p: Laclede Steel Co said on Tuesday that its program to reduce inventories did not fully achieve the level of productivity it expected in the fourth quarter ended December 31, although it remains encouraged by prospects to lower steelmaking costs in 1997.
The company posted an operating loss of $568,000 in the period, compared to a loss of $1.3 million one year ago, as sales climbed to $84.3 million from $75.6 million.
Laclede said it offered an early retirement incentive to some of its plant workers, resulting in a non-cash pretax charge of $1.6 million in the quarter.
Laclede is a steel manufacturing company. Its shares were closed down 1/8 Tuesday at 4-1/8.
